should this be an enum rather than a string?

Spelling out the options makes sense here, thanks. Changed this to an enum type.

One thing I want to call out -- these enum values are siblings of their type under C++ scoping, so this reserves `ReadOnly` and `Writable` for all of `runtime.v1`. If we later introduced another enum with one of these fields, protoc would reject it. It looks like the field is already inconsistent on this: some enums prefix their values, others don't, and some nest the enum.

Do you have a preference on this?
